en.headline: High Court orders Wang Fuk Court renovation consultant into liquidation
en.dek: Will Power Architects Company Limited, the firm that advised the Tai Po estate’s major renovation before the November 2025 fire, failed to appear on a creditor’s petition and was wound up today.
body: High Court Master Maurice Lam Chak Ming on Wednesday ordered Will Power Architects Company Limited into liquidation after the firm failed to appear on a creditor’s winding-up petition.

The petition was filed in June by creditor Tong Yiu-kwok. When the matter came before the Masters’ Chambers, Will Power sent neither a company representative nor solicitors. Master Lam granted the winding-up order and directed the company to pay the petitioner’s costs.

Will Power was the project consultant overseeing building inspection and repair supervision for Wang Fuk Court’s compulsory inspection works. The firm, the main contractor Prestige Construction & Engineering and seven individuals face criminal charges including manslaughter linked to the November 2025 No. 5 alarm fire that killed 168 people; those proceedings are separate from today’s civil order.

zh.headline: 宏福苑維修顧問鴻毅被頒令清盤
zh.dek: 擔任大埔宏福苑強制驗樓工程顧問的鴻毅建築師有限公司，今日在高等法院因債權人呈請而被頒令清盤，公司無人應訊。
body: 高等法院聆案官林澤銘周三頒令鴻毅建築師有限公司清盤。債權人唐耀國於六月入稟呈請，案件今日在聆案官法庭處理時，鴻毅既無公司代表亦無律師到庭應訊。
聆案官頒令清盤，並下令公司支付呈請人訟費。鴻毅是宏福苑強制驗樓及修葺工程的項目顧問，負責樓宇檢驗報告及工程監察。
該公司、主承建商宏業建築工程及七名人士已因2025年11月五級大火（造成168人死亡）被控誤殺等罪，刑事案件另案處理，與今日民事清盤令無關。
